## What It Does

Create, script, or produce marketing video content (AI-assisted or programmatic). Complements content-strategy and social.

## Harness Coverage

Targets verified harnesses: `antigravity`, `claude-code`, `codex`, `crush`, `cursor`, `gemini-cli`, `github-copilot`, `grok`, `opencode`.

```bash
npx skills add coreyhaines31/marketingskills --skill site-architecture --skill marketing-ideas --skill competitor-profiling --skill revops --skill churn-prevention --skill paywalls --skill launch --skill video -y -g -a antigravity claude-code codex crush cursor gemini-cli github-copilot grok opencode
```
